description.value: Pixwi is a BC pizza chain with outlets in Maple Ridge's Haney Place Mall and Burnaby's Metrotown, serving pizza, wings, garlic bread, and potato wedges. The Maple Ridge location sits inside a busy suburban mall along the Fraser Valley corridor, making it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the area. The menu spans vegetarian, chicken, and meat pizza options alongside sides like wings and potato wedges.

address.value: F2-11900 Haney Place Mall, Maple Ridge BC V2X 8R9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms two operating BC locations; OSM's addr:unit 'F2' matches the Maple Ridge outlet address 'F2-11900 Haney Place Mall, Maple Ridge BC V2X 8R9' shown on the website, placing this record at the Maple Ridge location. OSM check_date 2026-03-28 is recent and the website is live, confirming the business is open. The menu lists 'VEG. PIZZA' as a distinct category (vegetarian confirmed), and repeated 'ORDER ONLINE' / 'CALL FOR ORDER' calls-to-action confirm takeout service; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Website contains substantial leftover website-template placeholder content: a 'MAIN STREET, MELBOURNE, AUSTRALIA' contact address, 'INFO@FOODKING.COM' email, '+11002345909' phone, and a lorem-ipsum blog post attributed to 'rajradhanpura7@gmail.com' — the site was built on a food-industry template that was not fully cleaned up before publishing.
OSM record carries no phone or full street address fields; the address and phone used here were sourced from the website's outlet listing for the Maple Ridge location rather than OSM tags.

Pixwi has two BC outlets (Maple Ridge and Burnaby/Metrotown); this OSM record appears to correspond to Maple Ridge based on coordinates and addr:unit. The Metrotown location may warrant a separate OSM record if not already present.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating pizza fast food restaurant confirmed by a recent OSM check date (2026-03-28) and an active website with BC-specific outlet addresses and ordering functionality.
enrichment_extras.notes: Phone 604-479-2727 and address F2-11900 Haney Place Mall are specific to the Maple Ridge outlet as listed on the website. The Burnaby/Metrotown outlet uses phone 604-559-1999 at 1219-4500 Kingsway, Burnaby.
